# Dial Up Some Joy: First Watch Debuts “Feel Good Hotline” to Spark Everyday Delight


March 3, 2026


*The breakfast spot launches a nostalgic phone line designed to brighten day* s


**BRADENTON, Fla.** – **March 3, 2026** – In a world filled with constant notifications and digital noise,[First Watch](https://www.firstwatch.com/) , the beloved breakfast, brunch, and lunch spot, is embracing a nostalgic approach to spark moments of joy. With the launch of its new Feel Good Hotline, the popular restaurant has created a dedicated phone line designed to deliver uplifting messages, laughs and small moments of delight – all with the simple goal of making someone’s day a little brighter.


Rooted in the brand’s mission of making days brighter, the Feel Good Hotline blends nostalgia with modern hospitality. Each message is voiced by First Watch’s own team members across the country, everywhere from Kansas City to Dallas to Orlando and beyond, so anyone who gives it a ring can hear the real voices behind the brand. Callers can dial 1-844-KIND020 to access a menu of cheerful messages, including jokes, pep talks, microdoses of joy, affirmations and Chef’s Corner, featuring thoughtful tips from First Watch Corporate Chef Shane Schaibly. Callers can even leave their own messages of positivity, creating a ripple effect that extends beyond the breakfast table.


“At a time when people are craving more meaningful, human connection we wanted to create a moment that encourages them to slow down and smile,” said Matt Eisenacher, Chief Brand Officer at First Watch. “The Feel Good Hotline brings back the charm of an old-school phone call in a way that feels personal. It’s another way we’re extending our hospitality beyond our restaurants and into the everyday moments where people need a lift.”


The hotline taps into a growing cultural trend towards analog-inspired experiences that feel authentic and real. By reviving the experience of a classic phone call, it offers a refreshing alternative to the digital scroll – one that encourages people to reconnect with those little moments of joy.


**About** **First Watch**


First Watch is the leading Daytime Dining concept serving made-to-order breakfast, brunch and lunch using the freshest ingredients available. Guided by its “Follow the Sun” culinary philosophy, First Watch’s chef-driven menu rotates multiple times per year to feature the highest-quality flavors at their peak, offering elevated executions of classic favorites, fresh juices like the Kale Tonic, and fan favorites such as the Lemon Ricotta Pancakes, Quinoa Power Bowl and signature Million Dollar Bacon. For every kid’s meal served, First Watch proudly donates a portion to organizations and causes making a positive impact to our communities – raising approximately $2.0 million to date. A recipient of many “Best Breakfast” and “Best Brunch” awards, First Watch was voted #1 Best Breakfast by Newsweek’s Readers’ Choice Awards 2025, and also named 2025 and 2024’s #1 Most Loved Workplace in America by the Best Practice Institute – an accolade most recently featured in The Wall Street Journal – after appearing on the list in 2022 and 2023, as well. With a commitment to quality, hospitality and community, First Watch is redefining Daytime Dining across more than 630 First Watch restaurants in 32 states. For more information, visit[www.firstwatch.com](http://www.firstwatch.com/) .
